subject: computer-science
title: Logic Gates: AND, OR, NOT
welcome_lead: Every CPU is built from tiny switches that say YES or NO.
meta_desc: KS3 logic gates: AND, OR, NOT and truth tables.
final_note: Three gates can build any digital circuit ever made.

concepts.def: A circuit that follows a true/false rule.
True only if both inputs are true.
True if at least one input is true.
Flips true to false and false to true.
Table showing outputs for all inputs.
A signal coming into a gate.

walkthroughs.body_html: AND: needs all inputs true. OR: needs any input true. Think of doors with two locks vs two handles.
NOT (or inverter) has one input and flips it. If A is 1, NOT A is 0.
List every combination of inputs and what the output is. For two inputs that means 4 rows. Truth tables prove a circuit works.
